sentences.text:
18-08-2015
Shri R.S. Verma, Advocate for the applicant.
Heard on the point of admission.
Revision seems to be arguable, hence admitted for final hearing.
Records of the Courts below be called for.
Ms. Hemlata Kshatriya, Panel Lawyer for the respondent-State has taken notice of this admission, hence fresh notice is not required to be issued.

Also heard on I.A. No.
16072/2015, an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to applicant Damodar Malkani.

The applicant has been convicted under Section 7(1)/16(1)(A)(1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo R.I. for six months with fine of Rs.1,000/-. with default stipulation.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the matter.
It is further submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant was enlarged on bail during trial and he never misused the liberty granted to him.
There is no likelihood of coming up of this revision for final hearing in near future, hence, the sentence of the applicant may be suspended and he may be released on bail.
Learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent-State vehemently opposed the prayer for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to applicant.
On due consideration of the facts and circumstances of the case and the nature of allegation, this application is allowed.
It is directed that the execution of jail sentence of applicant Damodar Malkani shall remain suspended.

He is directed to be enlarged on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand Only) and a surety bond in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 06.05.2016 and on such other dates, which normally shall not be less than the period of 8 months,
as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard during the pendency of this revision.
It is made clear that the sentence of fine amount is not suspended.
List the case for final hearing in due course.
